remarks: Welcome to The Waterfront Village, a spacious & beautifully appointed, luxury mid-rise condominium; move-in ready and nestled in the heart of downtown Buffalo, situated directly on the water with stunning views of Lake Erie. This rare and picturesque unit rests in a peaceful area with professionally designed landscaping and desirable amenities including underground parking, whole building 24/7 security, and efficient geothermal heating and cooling systems. Featuring a charming & renovated kitchen with attractive cabinetry, distinctive Granite counters & backsplash, and breakfast bar with gorgeous engineered hardwood floors that flow into the generous living room with a stone-surround gas fireplace and dining area enhanced by floor to ceiling windows for an abundance of natural light and a sliding glass door opening onto the private balcony overlooking the scenic park-like mature trees and Buffalo’s incredibly unique skyline, perfect for sipping your morning coffee. Enjoy the bright & roomy bedroom with elegant 12 x 24 tile flooring with a separate sliding glass door to the balcony, thoughtfully designed to reduce wind coming off the lake. The updated bath showcases the jetted Jacuzzi, glamour spa soaking tub with a glass-enclosed tile shower surround, new fixtures & in-unit laundry for comfortable ease of living! Impeccably kept with choice finishes with one covered & enclosed parking space in the parking garage, elevator access for convenience, pet friendly with board approval & even having boat slip opportunities! Minutes away from Canalside, KeyBank Center, Erie Basin Marina, and all that downtown Buffalo has to offer, preeminent location mere steps from local shops & entertainment. Showings begin Wednesday, 10/21/26.
